title: 刺绣logo
prompt: A hyperrealistic embroidered textile artwork of the [SUBJECT], created with colored thread and soft fabric textures. The design features dense, tactile stitching and raised embroidery that mimics the actual form and branding. Set against a plain, off-white fabric background, with clean studio lighting and a sharp close-up view. Emphasize threadwork, texture, and handmade imperfections for a realistic soft sculpture look.
description: Nano Banana Pro与Nano Banana Pro助您打造超写实刺绣品牌雕塑，以细腻线迹和柔软织物质感呈现立体标识，适合高端产品展示与艺术化品牌项目，在纯净背景中凸显手工纹理的独特魅力。
